name: TakeoffCraft
changes_to_copied_files: Renamed pdf.worker.min.mjs, pdf.mjs, pdf.min.mjs, pdf.worker.mjs to .js (and every reference to them), so servers that do not know the .mjs type still serve them as JavaScript.
Library URLs written as /assets/vendor/<lib>/current/ are pinned to the versions listed in release.json.
notes: Snap to the PDF's own lines (F3), deduct segments (E), typed lengths and coordinates. Bid areas with add and deduct alternates, typical groups (×N), items that take several kinds of marks, a price library from CSV, labor by crew, and a bid summary with a proposal PDF. Compare a revised sheet and move the takeoff across. Back-outs, roof pitch and slopes, room fill (B), scales read from sheet text, auto count at any angle. Notes, clouds and highlights. A PDF that carries its takeoff. 3D: wall thickness, stacked floors, GLB and PNG. Recovery copy after a crash, touch, language files with a Spanish draft not yet reviewed.
